svg.title: H049 candidate architecture: sample-witness order-2 cut memory
svg.desc: Source-aligned editable vector architecture. Complete dated observed trees and persistent sampled-leaf identities feed reused two-sweep PyG computation. A candidate bidirectional rank-eight memory remaps pair-cell states using actual three-partition sample intersections between sweeps. Two matched controls replace this remapping. The inherited full-parent bidirectional GRU and H048 SNP plus 100-base-pair grid decoder produce four-class probabilities. This is a candidate, not an accepted or validated method.
svg.text: H049 candidate: sample-witness order-2 cut memory
Source-aligned architecture • candidate, not an accepted or validated method

g.text: A Complete observed tree sequence and cut relation
B One memory arm per matched model
Schematic identities a–e; e is sampled above 350 generations.
All 952 sampled leaves + all internal nodes remain in every whole-tree computation.
m(A,B) → m(B,C), weighted by n(A∩B∩C) / n(B∩C)
Pool within B using n(A∩B) / n(B); discard dependence on C
Keep a rank-8 state for each persistent sampled-leaf identity

svg.text: All arms: same U, O, ℓ parameterization; 513 memory scalars + 31,933 common scalars.
Identical warm start / fresh initialization; separate models and independent AdamW.

g.text: C Actual computation order: candidate memory enters between the two whole-tree sweeps
Candidate cut memory: actual two-direction, order-2 path
At real representative r: f = U(upward[r] + outside[r]) ∈ ℝ⁸
Persistent sample identities witness A ∩ B ∩ C; pair cells carry m(A,B).
1 At a changed partition: remap m(A,B) → m(B,C) using the selected arm.
2 Each native hold: m ← ρm + (1−ρ)f, ρ = exp(−span / ℓ).
3 Mean the two directions on leaves → mean within the current cut group.
4 Δ = O(read − f) ∈ ℝ³²; scatter only to actual representative nodes.
First state = f; unchanged partitions keep their layout. ℓ ∈ (100, 100,000) bp.

svg.text: Cut plan is a grouping relation,
not a pruned tree or cross-tree

g.text: D Reused SNP evidence + original 100-bp grid decoder (H048 graph_to_transition)

svg.text: Cut intersections use persistent sample identities only. Shown trees are schematic; no data, performance or novelty claim is encoded.
Editable vector artwork; exact block-to-function and line mapping, source hashes, and implementation notes accompany this SVG.
